headline: Man City's Elliot Anderson no handball call was correct - PL panel
description: The referee and VAR were correct to rule that Manchester City's Elliot Anderson did not handle the ball against Sunderland, a Premier League panel ruled.

headline: Man City should be stripped of titles - Jamie Carragher
description: Manchester City should be stripped of the titles won during the period where they have been found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules, Jamie Carragher said

headline: Man City to appeal guilty verdict in Premier League breaches case
description: Manchester City have until Friday to lodge an appeal against the guilty verdict handed down in their case with the Premier League and have stated publicly they intend to do so.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Real Madrid eye Van Dijk on free transfer at end of season
description: Real Madrid are hoping they can sign Virgil van Dijk when his Liverpool contract expires at the end of the season. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?
description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season

headline: Liverpool can't afford to be without Isak, Gakpo ahead of daunting October fixture list
description: Between them, Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak have scored five of Liverpool's seven league goals this season so their injuries during the international break could prove costly.
